articles.summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) transforms construction documentation by automatically mapping 360° imagery to architectural drawings and BIM models. This improves jobsite-to-office communication, reduces rework costs and ensures GDPR compliance through automated face blurring.
articles.title: From raw imagery to hard data: The crucial role of AI in construction documentation

articles.summary: SouthernCross Construction scaled its fleet to 24 Trimble-connected machines, using connected jobsite technology, drone surveys and real-time design updates to boost efficiency and growth.
articles.title: How SouthernCross turned jobsite precision into business growth
